project.title: Work outfits that feel polished without looking overdressed
project.platform: Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, YouTube Shorts

cast.woman_identity: Original adult woman in her late 20s, warm medium skin, deep brown eyes, medium-length dark auburn bob with a slight natural wave, expressive brows, slim natural build, 168 cm. Maintain same face and hairstyle in every look.
cast.man_identity: Original adult man in his early 30s, medium tan skin, dark brown eyes, neatly cropped dark brown hair with a natural hairline, lightly defined jaw, relaxed athletic build, 182 cm. Maintain same face and hairstyle in every look.

studio.description: A distinctive original fashion studio: pale limestone side wall, warm ivory pleated fabric backdrop, mid-tone walnut display plinth holding one small abstract clay sculpture at right, matte pale stone floor, soft daylight-style key from upper-left, gentle fill from the right, subtle floor shadows. Camera is at chest height, 35-50 mm full-frame equivalent lens, straight-on full-body two-person framing; fixed tripod; same floor marks and body scale.
